Only one API handler in the non-test server directory calls `Store.CreateMemo`.

`APIV1Service.CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` calls `Store.CreateMemo`. The Connect layer delegates to this service method instead of calling the store directly.

Store.CreateMemo does not appear in the frontend router.

APIV1Service.CreateMemo in memo_service.go directly calls Store.CreateMemo.

APIV1Service.CreateMemo — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go

That is the only API-layer handler in this repository that directly calls `Store.CreateMemo`. Other handlers such as `APIV1Service.CreateMemoComment` and `ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemo` create memos by calling `APIV1Service.CreateMemo`, not the store method directly.
